name: sgs/team-member
title: SGS Team Member
description: Team member card with photo, name, role, bio, and social links.

sgs._comment_mediaElements: 37-media-no-handroll remediation (2026-09-03, CORRECTED same day via /qc-council). NOT a new client control: prefix 'sgs' resolves (sgs_media_element_attr) to the SAME 'sgsObjectFit' attribute imageControlsExplicit's legacy image-controls extension already injects and already exposes an 'Object fit' dropdown for -- the original unprefixed entry here created a SECOND, dead 'Object fit' dropdown (QC-council finding: two identically-labelled controls in the same inspector) and, worse, left the legacy sgs_media_position_css() call in render.php free to emit a literal object-fit declaration from any PRE-EXISTING sgsObjectFit value on the SAME selector the atom now paints -- a live double-emission risk for any team-member instance saved before this fix, not just a cosmetic duplicate. render.php now clears sgsObjectFit before that call (mirrors sgs/gallery's identical fix) so only object-position emits from the legacy path, and the atom owns object-fit exclusively via this SAME attribute. style.css's hardcoded object-fit:cover was removed; the shared `.sgs-media-el{object-fit:var(--sgs-media-object-fit,cover)}` atom stylesheet paints the identical default.

card.label: Card
card._note: D294 content-KIND, no-wrapper (render.php:5-47) — the root <div> IS the block, no SGS_Container_Wrapper call (dropped 2026-07-10). FR-35-5 Task 4c fix (2026-07-21, Bean's Option A): the card now has a RESTING-state `cardShadow` attr (render.php:118,247-256; style.css –sgs-card-shadow fallback) alongside the existing hover-only `shadowHover` (render.php:239-243), so shadowHover is STATE_OK not STATE_WITHOUT_BASE — same fix shape as card-grid's cardShadow (Task 4). An empty cardShadow control means the card inherits the theme token exactly as before. `scaleHover` (transform:scale on hover) has no matching cluster member (no css:transform exists in the vocabulary) — an honest ORPHAN, not a gap. Typography FULLY migrated off native WP support (Bean-locked architecture decision, 2026-09-05, D971/D972 full-replacement track) — root prefix '' (fontSize/fontWeight/fontStyle/lineHeight via TypographyControls + sgs_typography_css_rule(); textAlign is now a plain block-private attribute rendered via the block's own has-text-align-* class mechanism, no longer WP-native supports.typography.textAlign). letter-spacing/text-transform/text-decoration/font-family are supported by the shared helper but have no editor control on this block yet — honest gaps.

image.label: Photo
image._note: Renamed from 'photo' 2026-08-15 (element-manifest drift fix) — imageZoomHover resolves to css_element='image' via the cross-block classification override (scripts/attr-classification-overrides.json), the SAME vocabulary token already declared by sgs/card-grid, sgs/gallery and sgs/post-grid for this identical hover-effect pattern. The real rendered class is `.sgs-team-member__photo` (render.php:295) — the label stays 'Photo' (client-facing, unchanged) even though the manifest KEY is now 'image', matching the sibling-block vocabulary. Governed by the universal image-controls extension (supports.sgs.imageControls) plus photoShape/overlayHover/grayscaleHover/imageZoomHover behaviour toggles — none are Text/Fill/Layout style-cluster members. `grayscaleHover` claimed via `states.hover.attrMap` (css:filter) 2026-08-28 — real CSS behind a class toggle, invisible to the classifier's usual attrMap-scan shape until declared explicitly here.

name.label: Name
name._note_hover: nameColourHover (2026-09-05) -- render.php:637-639 emits sgs_hover_state_rules( $name_colour_sel, 'color:...', ':focus-visible' ), where $name_colour_sel = $root_sel . ' .sgs-team-member__name' (render.php:627). That is the NAME element's OWN :hover/:focus-visible, not the card root's, so css_element=name / css_state=hover is what render.php actually does. Declared explicitly because the `name` prefix convention resolves css:color to the RESTING nameColour only -- it cannot reach a state, so without this entry the derived DB left css_element/css_state NULL and nameColourHover collided with roleColourHover on the identical (color, NULL, NULL) routing slot.
name._note: css:color resolves via the default convention (nameColour). No nameFontSize/nameFontWeight/etc attrs exist — honest gaps; only the card-root fontSize (typography.fontSize) governs name/role/bio text size uniformly. `attrMap.tag` added (D-pending, E12 scoping fix) — `headingLevel` sets the rendered tag on this element (render.php:320, `.sgs-team-member__name`) but doesn't match the `name` prefix convention on its own. `nameColourGradient` (2026-09-03) is the text-colour gradient sibling to nameColour, same background-clip:text mechanism as sgs/counter's numberColourGradient.

role.label: Role
role._note_hover: roleColourHover (2026-09-05) -- render.php:648-650 emits sgs_hover_state_rules( $role_colour_sel, 'color:...', ':focus-visible' ), where $role_colour_sel = $root_sel . ' .sgs-team-member__role' (render.php:628). The ROLE element's own :hover/:focus-visible, exactly mirroring nameColourHover above. Same reason for the explicit declaration: the `role` prefix convention only reaches the resting roleColour, leaving the hover attribute at (color, NULL, NULL) and colliding with nameColourHover.
role._note: css:color resolves via the default convention (roleColour, default 'text-muted'). No per-element font-size/weight — honest gaps. `roleColourGradient` (2026-09-03) is the text-colour gradient sibling to roleColour, same background-clip:text mechanism.

bio.label: Bio
bio._note: No bio-specific style attribute exists at all (no bioColour, no bioFontSize) — honest zero-cluster element; bio text inherits the card root's colour/typography.

social.label: Social links
social._note: socialLinks is a content array (platform+url); icons are fixed Lucide glyphs (render.php:290-349) with no per-icon colour/size style controls.

photoDecorative.description: Marks the photo as purely decorative (empty alt + aria-hidden) — for edge cases such as a placeholder silhouette graphic. Most team photos identify the person and should keep their alt text.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
